purpose.summary: CRP019 is a creditor cheques-issued reporting program in an accounts payable / creditor management system. It reads creditor, transaction, and parameter files to produce printed reports of cheques issued to creditors, with aging analysis (30–180 days). It supports interactive CRT screen display and printer output.

verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 characters; the PROCEDURE DIVISION is not visible but the structural indicators (72 PERFORMs, 60 GOTOs, 295 PIC clauses, 1153 code lines) confirm a substantial production program. The $set directive and .GNT extension strongly indicate Micro Focus COBOL or ACUCOBOL-GT. The program has been maintained since 1983 through at least June 2018 (version 9.04.05). COPY statements reference external copybooks that are not shown.
